privacy.title: Privacy & Anonymity
privacy.subtitle: See what the swarm can learn about you — and lock it down.
privacy.restartNote: Applied. This takes effect after the next app restart.
privacy.posture.checkingDesc: Checking tunnel routes and exit IP addresses.
privacy.posture.protectedDesc: Checked Internet routes use a tunnel. The kill-switch pauses activity when this can no longer be confirmed.
privacy.posture.cautionDesc: Enable the kill-switch to pause activity when the tunnel route is lost or cannot be verified.
privacy.posture.exposedDesc: Havvn cannot confirm a local VPN tunnel. Your exit IP may already belong to a remote gateway; this does not identify your home country.
privacy.route.detectedDesc: A tunnel adapter exists, but Havvn cannot confirm that the checked Internet routes use it without an IPv6 bypass. Check TUN, split routing and IPv6 settings.
privacy.route.ipv6Bypass: IPv4 uses a tunnel, but an IPv6 route uses another adapter. The kill-switch treats this as unconfirmed protection.
privacy.dash.proxyNote: A system proxy affects supported web requests. Its IP and country do not confirm protection of torrent peer traffic.
privacy.dash.ipUnavailable: The exit IP lookup failed. Local route detection still works independently.
privacy.dash.whatPeersSee: IP location describes a network exit, not your physical location or home country. This HTTPS probe does not verify the address seen by torrent peers; application and split-routing rules may differ.
privacy.leak.isp: This IP appears to belong to a consumer ISP, not a VPN — your real location may be exposed to peers. Connect a VPN before downloading.
privacy.preset.title: Recommended privacy setup
privacy.preset.desc: One click: enable the VPN kill-switch and VPN-on-startup check, sanitize logs, and disable DHT to shrink your exposure.
privacy.preset.applied: Recommended privacy settings applied. DHT change takes effect after restart.
privacy.dht.desc: Finds peers without a tracker. Turning it off makes you harder to discover and queryable by fewer nodes — recommended with private trackers. Takes effect after restart.
privacy.connection.note: Peer connections always announce your IP to the swarm — only a VPN hides it. PEX is always on and LSD isn’t used by the engine.
privacy.vpn.notDetectedDesc: Your real IP address may be visible to peers. Consider using a VPN for better privacy.
privacy.vpn.unknownDesc: Network routes could not be verified. This does not confirm that a VPN is absent or protecting traffic.
privacy.enc.unavailableDesc: Your system doesn't support secure encryption. Data will be obfuscated but not fully encrypted.
privacy.ephemeralId.desc: The BitTorrent peer ID is randomized every launch (no machine-identifying data), so peers can't correlate your sessions over time.
privacy.vpnDetection.desc: Warn at startup when an Internet route through a local tunnel cannot be confirmed.
privacy.killSwitch.desc: Check local routes every 5 seconds. Pause active torrents and room networking if the tunnel route is missing or uncertain, including an IPv6 bypass. Torrent resume is manual. Detection is reactive; use the VPN client's own kill-switch for immediate blocking.
privacy.vpnBind.desc: Bind native-engine peer sockets to the tunnel selected by checked IPv4 routes. IPv6 peers are blocked. If no suitable tunnel is found, bind to loopback. Applied at engine startup.
privacy.vpnBind.engineOnly: Requires the native engine — WebTorrent cannot bind to a specific network interface.
privacy.vpnBind.pending: Binding change is saved and will apply after a restart.
privacy.vpnBind.noVpn: No tunnel selected by the checked IPv4 routes. The engine is bound to loopback and cannot reach peers. Check the VPN's TUN mode and routing configuration.
privacy.vpnBind.lostBanner: Tunnel route unconfirmed — the bound engine is being restarted; check its binding status in Privacy.
privacy.encSecrets.desc: Proxy password and search-provider API keys are encrypted at rest using OS-level encryption (Keychain / DPAPI / libsecret).
privacy.clearOnExit.desc: Automatically delete logs and temporary data when closing the app.
privacy.sanitizeLogs.desc: Remove or hash sensitive data (IPs, IDs) in log files.
privacy.disableLogs.desc: Completely disable file logging. ⚠️ Makes debugging difficult.
privacy.clearAll.desc: Permanently delete all data including reputation, downloads, and settings. This action cannot be undone!
privacy.tips.title: Privacy Tips
privacy.tips.vpnText: It is the only thing here that actually hides your real IP from peers.
privacy.tips.killSwitchText: It auto-pauses torrents if your VPN drops, so a brief outage can’t leak your IP.
privacy.tips.dhtText: It reduces who can discover you; many private trackers require it off.
privacy.tips.privateText: Enable the "Private torrent" option when creating torrents to keep them off DHT/PEX.

history.unavailable: File unavailable. History does not restore or download deleted files.
history.paused: This file is incomplete and the download is stopped. Resume it in Downloads to continue watching.
history.checkFailed: Could not check files. Waiting to reconnect.

external.title: Open in external player
external.saved: The application choice is saved automatically. Select vlc.exe or mpv.exe on Windows.
external.ready: File downloaded. Opening it will not start downloading or seeding.
external.defaultPosition: The default application opens the file without a playback position. Choose VLC or mpv to continue from this point.
external.historyHint: Havvn does not receive the external player’s playback position. History keeps the last position saved in Havvn.
external.mpvHistoryHint: mpv playback position is saved to history through IPC while Havvn is running. Choose tracks separately in the external player.
external.error.too-many-players: Too many mpv windows are tracking playback. Close one and try again.
external.error.invalid-file: Choose an audio or video file from this torrent. Programs and other file types cannot be opened here.
external.error.missing-file: File not found. Check that it is still in the download folder.
external.error.incomplete-file: Download this file completely before opening it externally.
external.error.missing-player: The selected player is unavailable. Choose its executable again or use the default application.
external.error.unsupported-player: Select the VLC or mpv executable. Other programs are not supported here.
external.error.launch-failed: Could not open the file. Check the selected player or the system application for this file type.
external.error.unavailable: Could not open the player or load its settings. Please try again.
external.streaming: This file is still downloading. Keep Havvn running: the player receives verified pieces as they arrive. Seeking to a missing part will wait for data. Sequential download can be enabled in the torrent’s files.
external.error.stream-player: Choose VLC or mpv for an incomplete file. The default application is available for fully downloaded files.
external.error.paused-file: The download is stopped. Resume it manually or wait until the file is complete.
external.error.excluded-file: This file is excluded from downloading. Select it in the torrent’s files first.
external.error.too-many-streams: Four streams are already open. Close a player or stop one of the streams below.
external.stopHint: Stopping disconnects the player. The torrent will keep downloading.
external.sessionsError: Could not refresh or stop streams. Please try again.
rooms.engine.failedBody: Havvn could not start or lost the room engine. Retry the connection. Voice and screen sharing must be started again manually.
rooms.storage.title: Room secrets are locked
rooms.storage.unavailable: System secret storage is unavailable. Restore access under the original OS account and retry. Room data has been kept.
rooms.storage.decrypt-failed: Could not unlock room secrets. Restore the original OS account/keychain or an intact backup, then retry. Room data has been kept.
rooms.storage.migration-failed: Could not protect the saved room. Check system secret storage and disk access, then retry. The original record has been kept.
rooms.storage.unsupported: This room uses an unsupported storage version. Open it with a compatible Havvn version. Room data has been kept.
rooms.storage.write-failed: Room changes could not be saved. Restore system secret storage and disk access, then retry before closing Havvn. The previous disk record is intact.
rooms.inviteAccess: Anyone with the current invite can join. Removal blocks that profile; a new identity and a newly shared invite can allow access again. Files and keys already received cannot be revoked.
rooms.receive.first: Move to the front of the receive queue
rooms.receive.summaryHint: The two receive slots are shared across all desktop rooms.
settings.roomResources.title: Room traffic and screen sharing
settings.roomResources.scope: File limits are shared across desktop rooms. Voice, screen sharing, LAN, game servers and regular torrents use separate connections.
settings.roomResources.shared: Default: 256 KB/s across all rooms. Per-room limits can only lower the allocation. 0 removes this total ceiling.
settings.roomResources.zero: 0 = no total download ceiling. Available bandwidth is divided between room file clients.
settings.roomResources.voiceHint: While you are in a room call, reduce total file upload to at most 64 KB/s and download to 2048 KB/s. Lower limits stay in effect.
settings.roomResources.screenHint: 250–20000 kbit/s; default 2500. Multiple participants multiply outgoing video traffic. The encoder may use less; audio and transport overhead are additional.
settings.roomResources.failed: Could not apply settings; saved values will be retried on room activation
settings.roomResources.applied: Room resource settings saved and applied
rooms.newAutoFetchHint: Off by default: files appear in the room and you choose what to download. You can change this later.
rooms.existingAutoFetchHint: Rejoining an existing room keeps its previous preference.
rooms.fileAllocationHint: Shared between room clients, created when a file is requested. Configure the total in Settings → Sharing.
rooms.diag.title: Connection diagnostics
rooms.diag.retryStarted: Discovery restarted. Existing calls and file transfers continue.
rooms.diag.pathHint: Direct/TURN is measured from the selected ICE pair. Peer relay here forwards room messages; files, voice and LAN establish their own connections.
rooms.diag.notJoined: You are not in the call
rooms.diag.observationsHint: Session observations, not proof that every tracker is down or that the invite is incorrect. Recent history contains at most 24 events.
rooms.diag.privacy: The report contains status, counts and event times. It excludes invite codes, keys, TURN credentials, addresses, SDP/ICE, participant names/IDs, file names/paths and chat contents.
rooms.diag.hint.discovering: Waiting for a tracker reply. Check the connection if tracker problems continue.
rooms.diag.hint.waiting: Rooms have no central file server. Another participant needs to be online. An empty room does not prove that the invite is incorrect.
rooms.diag.hint.connecting: A peer was found, but its transport channel is not open yet.
rooms.diag.hint.authenticating: Waiting for a readable, accepted greeting from the peer.
rooms.diag.hint.syncing: The greeting was accepted; waiting for the full manifest or room key.
rooms.diag.hint.ready: A peer greeting was accepted. File, voice and LAN connections have their own status below.
rooms.diag.hint.offline: Live connection information is unavailable. Retry discovery to reactivate this room.
rooms.diag.hint.engine-failed: The connection engine stopped. Previous observations are retained; retry to restart it.
rooms.diag.hint.suspended: Restore the connection, including VPN if required, before retrying. Diagnostics does not resume networking.
rooms.diag.hint.removed: This profile was removed. Retrying cannot restore access.
rooms.voice.waitingForSlot: Waiting for a voice slot. This mesh supports 9 participants; your microphone is not transmitted while waiting.
rooms.fileLimitReached: Room manifest limit reached (5000 files or 16 MiB of metadata). Remove files and retry connection to synchronize again. Existing files are preserved.
rooms.data.title: Room data
rooms.data.cleanupHint: Only managed copies of this room are removed. Publications, source files and keys remain. Receiving stays paused until you choose Download. If no other member has a copy, it cannot be downloaded again.
rooms.data.protectedCipher: Protected {size} of cache for your publications: encrypting again changes the torrent hash, so this copy is kept.
rooms.data.skipped: Unsafe or unavailable paths skipped: {n}. They are never removed.
rooms.data.cleanupConfirm: Free {size}? Seeding these copies will stop. Publications and keys remain, but restoring a file requires a member with a copy.
rooms.data.cleaned: Freed {size}. Receiving cleaned files is paused.
rooms.data.retentionConfirm: Change retention? Messages and events outside the selected period will be removed from local storage. Other members are unaffected.
rooms.data.historyHint: Up to 5,000 messages and 5,000 events per room, 50 per page. Message retention starts when received on this PC. History is local: peers may send previously received messages again. Save needed texts separately before shortening retention — the identity backup does not include history.
rooms.data.cursorExpired: History changed. Showing the latest records.
rooms.data.backupHint: The backup includes this profile’s identity, all rooms, publications, signatures and old keys. Files, history, LAN and server settings are excluded. The password is required to restore it. Plaintext JSON backups are no longer used.
rooms.data.backupConsent: I will keep the password separately and will not share this backup.
rooms.data.restoreHint: Restore into a profile with no joined rooms. This replaces its identity and memberId with those in the backup, then requires a restart. Do not run one identity on two PCs simultaneously. Files must be fetched again; automatic downloading is disabled.
rooms.data.restoreConsent: I understand the current identity will be replaced.
rooms.data.restored: Identity and rooms restored. The old session has stopped; restart Havvn to continue.
rooms.data.roomBackupHint: The backup includes your identity, this room, its publications, signatures and old keys. Files, history, LAN and server settings are excluded. Restoring requires the password.
rooms.data.untracked: Another {size} belongs to copies without a verified publication mapping. They are included in disk usage but are never removed automatically.
rooms.server.lifecyclePaused: Automatic starts are paused after leaving the room or a connection change. The world will be kept. Once stopped, press Start to resume the server and its schedule.
rooms.server.err.room-unavailable: The room is unavailable. Restore its connection before starting the server.
rooms.server.err.command-unknown: The host did not confirm acceptance. The command may have reached the process; check the console before sending it again.
rooms.server.err.command-expired: The command expired or is invalid. It was not accepted.
rooms.server.err.command-conflict: This command ID was already used for different content.
rooms.server.err.command-busy: The host command queue is full. Try again later.
rooms.server.console.accepted: Accepted by process stdin. See the console for the game response.
rooms.server.local.title: Local servers
rooms.server.local.emptyHint: Servers kept when leaving a room appear here, including stopped servers and their worlds.
rooms.server.local.summary: Running: {running}. Active schedules: {schedules}. Closing Havvn stops these processes.
rooms.server.local.note: Local server: no room announcements or remote operators. Schedules and restart policy are controlled here.
rooms.server.local.addressHint: Local connection address. The game retains its own listen settings; the room LAN is disconnected.
rooms.server.leave.stopHint: Recommended. Wait for the processes to stop. Worlds and settings remain available under Local servers. Schedules and automatic restarts are disabled.
rooms.server.leave.localHint: Keep current processes running in Havvn. Disconnect room access and disable schedules and automatic restarts. Manage them under Local servers. Installed worlds and settings are kept; game listen settings stay the same.

appearance.description: Native Acrylic, local backgrounds and complete appearance profiles.
appearance.nativeMaterial.acrylic.hint: Blurs the desktop and windows behind Havvn for a more expressive glass effect.
appearance.nativeMaterial.mica.hint: Picks up wallpaper colors for a calmer workspace. Other windows do not show through.
appearance.nativeCovered: An in-app background is selected. Choose Desktop / theme background to reveal the system material.
appearance.native.system: Transparency is paused by Windows accessibility settings. Your preference is preserved.
appearance.native.off: Enable a Windows material behind the app. Requires Windows 11 22H2 or later.
appearance.native.active: The system material is enabled. Adjust the backdrop strength below.
appearance.native.unsupported: System materials require Windows 11 22H2+. Internal glass remains available on this system.
appearance.native.failed: Windows could not enable this window's material. A solid background is used.
appearance.previewText: Glass uses the selected palette and keeps text readable.
appearance.backgroundHint: A local image or gradient covers the desktop Acrylic backdrop.
appearance.imageError: Choose a PNG, JPEG or WebP up to 2 MB and 8192 × 8192 pixels.
appearance.motionHint: Disabled by reduced motion and lightweight mode.
appearance.replaceHint: This name already exists. Updating replaces that profile with your current appearance.
appearance.profileLimit: All 8 slots are used. Update an existing profile or delete one to add another.
appearance.noProfiles: No saved profiles yet. Save your current appearance above or load a profile from a file.
appearance.profileFilesHint: Download the current appearance to keep a copy or move it to another device. Loading adds a profile to the list; apply it when you are ready.
appearance.profileImported: Profile loaded and selected. Choose “Apply profile” to use it.
appearance.profilesHint: Keep your favourite looks here. Save the current appearance or apply a profile from your collection.
appearance.saveError: Could not save or apply. Check available storage and try again.
appearance.editorHint: Close the theme editor before saving or applying a full appearance profile.
appearance.glassInEditorHint: Glass, highlights and corners are edited and saved with your theme.
appearance.themeGlassHint: Glass is saved with the theme for both modes. Closing without saving discards changes. Acrylic and the backdrop stay in Interface settings.
rooms.chatPinsHint: Up to 10 shared pins, managed by the room owner.
rooms.chatSearchLocal: Searching saved history on this device
rooms.request.fileGone: Linked file removed from the room
rooms.watchReady.waiting: Waiting for viewers to be ready
rooms.sync.checkpointLocal: This local version is outside the owner's checkpoint. The file and history are preserved; text can be viewed and copied. Publishing requires an explicit import at a new path.
rooms.sync.checkpointHint: Start a new active journal epoch. The owner signs current versions and rights; previous history stays in a local verified archive.
rooms.sync.checkpointCounts: Archive generation: {generation}. Records to archive: {records}. Current versions: {heads}.
rooms.sync.checkpointArchives: Archived epochs after this operation: {n} of {max}.
rooms.sync.checkpointCompatibility: Upgrading to protocol v{version} is irreversible. Clients without v{version} stop receiving updates for this folder. Automatic modes on bound devices pause until explicitly resumed.
rooms.sync.checkpointOffline: Offline edits stay on their device. Review branches outside the checkpoint through history and explicitly republish them if authorized. New members receive current versions; earlier history remains on devices that retained it.
rooms.sync.checkpointLimits: Up to 2000 current versions and 8 archived epochs, subject to storage quota. Large checkpoints arrive in parts and are fully verified before acceptance. The 10,000 revision limit applies to the new active epoch. Archives are never automatically discarded.
rooms.sync.checkpointDone: Checkpoint created. Review local files and resume the automatic modes you need.
rooms.sync.logHint: Compaction reduces the local journal size. All versions, signatures, move history and unsent changes are preserved. File contents and backups are untouched.
rooms.sync.logLimits: Compaction preserves the entire history and does not reset version limits. Publishing stops at the limit. Sizes are shown before system storage protection; actual disk usage may differ.
rooms.sync.logCompatibility: On this device, the compacted journal requires Havvn with the new storage format. Other members continue receiving ordinary signed records.
rooms.sync.logNoSaving: The journal is already compact or too small to save more space.
rooms.sync.movePath: New path relative to the shared folder
rooms.sync.moveHint: For example: configs/game.ini. History is preserved and the move reaches all members. The destination must be free; save or resolve local changes first. Case-only renames are not supported yet.
rooms.sync.pathHint: Choose the contents of this document and a free path. Havvn will save a new version and share it with members.
rooms.sync.pathMore: Showing the first 32 other versions. The remaining files are available in the file list.
rooms.sync.pathPreserve: Existing local files will remain in place and all branch history will be retained. If the old bytes could belong to another document, its updates will pause until reviewed. Members receive a move; their local changes are protected by the usual conflict checks.
rooms.sync.trashStorageHint: Select up to 100 local copies and review cleanup. Only selected bytes on this device are removed; history records and peers' trash remain.
rooms.sync.trashStorageRecovery: Cleanup requires a separate verified local copy with exactly the same bytes. Unfinished operations and local edits without such a copy are protected. Private cache is stored separately from trash.
rooms.sync.trashStorageUnknown: Some files could not be verified. They are protected; the displayed size may be incomplete.
rooms.sync.trashStorageSelection: Selected copies: {n}. Review cleanup before deleting.
rooms.sync.trashStoragePartial: Cleanup stopped. Remaining copies were preserved. Review the refreshed list.
rooms.sync.trashStorageChanged: Trash or its recovery copy changed. Refresh the list and review cleanup again.
rooms.sync.trashStorageUnavailable: The connected folder is unavailable. Reconnect the disk and scan again.
rooms.sync.trashStorageEmpty: No local trash copies. Deletion journals remain for state recovery.
rooms.sync.trashStorageReason.ready: Verified copy available in private cache
rooms.sync.trashStorageReason.exported: Verified saved copy exists outside Havvn
rooms.sync.trashExportHint: Save unique local edits to a separate file outside shared folders. Once verified, the original can be selected for manual cleanup. Keep the saved file intact if you need it for recovery.
rooms.sync.trashExportDone: Copy saved and verified: {file}. The original stays in the trash; cleanup requires separate confirmation.
rooms.sync.trashExportSummary: Save unique edits separately, then review cleanup of the originals.
rooms.sync.trashStorageHelp: How copies are saved and cleaned up
rooms.sync.trashExportExists: This file already exists. Choose a new name; exports never replace existing files.
rooms.sync.trashExportOutside: Save the copy outside shared folders and Havvn application storage.
rooms.sync.trashExportReceiptFailed: The file was saved, but its receipt could not be stored. The original remains protected. Check disk access and restart Havvn.
rooms.sync.trashExportFailed: The export could not be verified. Its destination may be incomplete. The original remains in the trash and cannot be cleaned up based on this attempt.
rooms.sync.trashExportLimit: The export receipt limit has been reached. The original stays protected and saved copies are kept.
rooms.sync.trashStorageReason.unverified: Protected: files or authority not verified
rooms.sync.trashStorageReason.unavailabl: Protected: separate copy unavailable or cannot be decrypted
rooms.sync.trashStorageReason.different: Protected: local bytes differ from the shared version
rooms.sync.trashStorageReason.busy: Protected: used by the queue or recovery
rooms.sync.missingHint: Files that disappeared from the connected folder. Havvn waits for another scan and sends no deletions without your confirmation. Review each file separately.
rooms.sync.missingRecovery: Havvn will verify the retained last shared version before sending. Peers move their working copy to trash. Another program already removed your local file; Havvn cannot recover its unpublished changes.
rooms.sync.missingMassHint: Check the disk and folder contents. A directory may have moved or a program may have failed. Sending all deletions with one click is unavailable.
rooms.sync.missingMassAck: I checked the folder and want to review these deletions one at a time
rooms.sync.missingCounts: Ready for review: {n} · Waiting for another scan: {waiting}
rooms.sync.missingWaiting: Another scan takes a few seconds. Saving a file can make it disappear briefly.
rooms.sync.missingEmpty: No confirmed deletions. Excluded files, conflicts and unapplied versions are omitted.
rooms.sync.missingChanged: The file, folder or sync state changed. Reopen the deletions list and review it again.
rooms.sync.missingDeleteHint: Only this file will be deleted. Peers with receiving enabled move their working copy to trash. The verified last shared version stays in protected cache for restoration through history.
rooms.sync.missingBlocked.unavailable: The folder or disk is unavailable. Sending deletions is stopped. Reconnect the disk and scan again.
rooms.sync.missingBlocked.changed: A different folder was found at this path. Sending deletions is stopped. Check its contents and reconnect the intended folder.
rooms.sync.missingBlocked.incomplete: Contents changed during the scan. Sending deletions is stopped until a complete new scan.
rooms.sync.missingBlocked.directory: An entire subdirectory disappeared. Sending deletions is stopped. Restore it and check whether it was moved.
rooms.sync.missingBlocked.all: No accessible files remain in the folder. Sending deletions is stopped. Check the disk and selected folder.
rooms.sync.metadataHint: Save the signed log to an encrypted file before removing old epochs. Importing an archive restores history without changing shared heads or permissions.
rooms.sync.metadataContents: The archive contains names, signatures and version links. It excludes file contents, room keys and local paths. Restoring contents requires a cached copy or an available member. Save outside shared folders to a new file.
rooms.sync.metadataKeep: Keep the latest epochs of each type (0–8)
rooms.sync.metadataExportNeeded: Save a new export of the current history before cleanup. A removed or modified export cannot be used.
rooms.sync.metadataBlocked: Recovery journals could not be verified. Cleanup is unavailable; history export remains available.
rooms.sync.metadataCacheHint: Cached epochs become removable after unneeded copies are released through the version cache limit. Active transfers, working versions and trash are protected. Review cleanup again afterwards.
rooms.sync.metadataEmpty: There are no old archived epochs yet.
rooms.sync.metadataReason.recovery: Required by recovery or an open preview
rooms.sync.metadataDone: Selected metadata removed. Working files, cache and trash are preserved.
rooms.sync.metadataChanged: History or folder state changed. Review cleanup again.
rooms.sync.metadataForeign: This archive belongs to a different shared folder or has an invalid format.
rooms.sync.metadataOutside: Save the archive outside shared folders and Havvn application storage.
rooms.sync.metadataExists: This file already exists. Choose a new name for the export.
